messages:
anya: ok team — we need a quick call on Optimize toolkit sequencing. two customer asks just landed: 1) enterprise customer wants aggressive quantization support (8-bit/4-bit profiles + canary guidance) 2) infra folks want better automatic batching hints and a lightweight prefix cache. what should we prioritize for next sprint?

devon: +1 on batching hints for ops efficiency. those give immediate latency/cost wins across customers. quantization is high-impact but risky and needs infra infra (validation, metrics, rollout).

sam: agree with devon. quant is high effort: model validation matrix, perf regressions, evals. batching/cache are lower effort and unlock obvious $/token wins.

li: from customer success — enterprise will pay for quantization if we can promise no quality regressions and clear rollback. they asked for a launch checklist: metrics, evals, canary, KMS compatibility.

anya: trying to frame this with RICE so we can be objective. very rough:
```
Feature         Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort  RICE
Quantization     1.2k   8       0.6         40      144
Batching hints   4.5k   3       0.8         10      108
Prefix caching   3.2k   4       0.75        15      64
```
Numbers super hand-wavy — reach = monthly routes impacted, impact on ordinal scale, effort = engineering person-days.

devon: that table helps. quantization RICE looks higher here but effort is huge and risk non-linear. I vote: batch hints (MVP) -> prefix cache (MVP) -> quantization (phase gated).

sam: propose splitting quantization work into two stories: quant infra (validation harness + perf benchmarks) and quant model profiles (actual quant knobs). we can start infra (low-medium effort) concurrently after batching. that reduces perceived effort for later.

li: customer ask prioritization: enterprise signs if we have a canary plan + regressions alerting. if we can commit to starting quant infra this quarter and show a canary plan, they might accept a timeline.

anya: consensus forming. quick vote: options — A) batching-first, start quant-infra; B) quant-first full; C) cache-first then batching. react with :one: / :two: / :three: or comment.

devon: :one:

sam: :one: and starting quant infra (agree with splitting)

li: :one: — but include canary checklist in plan doc (LI will draft).

deploy-bot: Notice: a doc stub was created — /docs/optimize/prioritization/1728001234-rice-decision (anya created).

anya: next steps — li will draft canary checklist and customer note; devon will scope batching hints MVP and list measurable SLOs; sam will sketch quant infra spike (2w). i'll consolidate into a PRD by Friday. thanks folks.
